subject: Acme pen test: report delivery, artifact lookup, and remediation routing
messages:
From: Jared Bloom <jared.bloom@acme.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: full penetration test report + artifact bundle

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Acme's Security Ops team has completed the external-facing penetration test we commissioned for the payments integration in July. We need the following to close our SIG and CAIQ workflows: 

- The full PT report (vendor PDF) and a list of the assets that were in-scope.
- Any raw artifact bundle (pcap, screenshots, exploit PoCs) that the vendor provided.
- A simple mapping of findings -> owner (team or engineer) and current remediation status.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide these artifacts and an estimated delivery date? If anything is sensitive, we can accept a redacted bundle through a secure transfer link.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Acme's procurement/security team is aiming to close the questionnaire by next Friday (2026-08-13).

Thanks,
Jared
Security Operations | Acme Payments
[Attachment: acme_request_v1.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, Jared Bloom <jared.bloom@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: full penetration test report + artifact bundle

Folks — forwarding Acme's request. TL;DR: they need the pen test PDF, artifacts, and a findings -> owner mapping for SIG/CAIQ closure. 

Actions I need: 
- Monica: can Security consolidate the vendor report (redwood copy) and confirm what can be shared (redaction guidance)?
- Rishi: can Eng provide the owner mapping and a brief remediation ETA per finding? We likely need a tracker.
- Evelyn: can CS confirm any contractual constraints (SLA/retention) and whether Acme has a signed DTA?

Timeline: Acme wants to close by 2026-08-13. If we can't meet that, propose the earliest feasible date.

Markus Klein
Director, Technical Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: acme_request_v1.pdf (forwarded)]

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, Jared Bloom <jared.bloom@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 13:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: full penetration test report + artifact bundle

Markus / team,

We have the vendor's final report in our secure evidence bucket and an artifacts archive produced by the tester. I checked the contract and the vendor allows sharing with customers under an NDA — Acme's request is fine. We should redact internal IP@hostnames and any internal-only ticket IDs.

Plan: 
1) Security will prepare a redacted PDF copy and bundle the artifacts (pcap/screenshots) into a password-protected zip.
2) We'll create a simple mapping CSV (finding id, severity, brief description, owner_alias) based on the report.
3) Engineering to populate remediation status and ETA for each owner row.

I'll own step 1 and the mapping skeleton. ETA for the redacted bundle and skeleton mapping: EOD Thursday 2026-08-06.

Questions: Rishi — do you want the mapping skeleton in Jira or a shared spreadsheet? If Jira, please give the project/key; if spreadsheet, we'll attach it to the bundle and share a link.

Monica Patel
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: internal_vendor_report_storage_path.txt]

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, Jared Bloom <jared.bloom@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: full penetration test report + artifact bundle

Thanks Monica — spreadsheet is fine for initial handoff. We'll import into Jira after owners confirm.

Quick status from Eng: 
- I reviewed the report and assigned owners for 14 findings across infra, auth, and payments svc. I've started filling the remediation column for low/medium items. High/critical will need immediate work: two tickets are created (PAY-3421, AUTH-7810).
- Estimated dates: low/med items -> 2026-08-20; high/critical -> mitigations live by 2026-08-11 with follow-up fixes by 2026-08-25.

I'll attach a short remediation summary and the owner list once I sync with the leads this afternoon. If Acme needs proof (screenshots of fixes / PRs) we can include links to the PRs and internal ticket IDs in the tracker.

Rishi Malhotra
Principal Engineer, Platform
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_remediation_summary.txt]

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Jared Bloom <jared.bloom@acme.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2026 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: full penetration test report + artifact bundle

Hi Jared — quick update and next steps.

We can provide a redacted PDF of the vendor report plus a password-protected artifacts bundle. Attached is the remediation tracker (skeleton populated by Monica + initial owner/ETA from Rishi).

What we're delivering by the end of day Monday (2026-08-09):
- Redacted report PDF (redwood_redacted_pt_report_acme_2026-07.pdf)
- Artifacts bundle (password-protected .zip) with a checksum and password sent via separate secure channel
- Remediation tracker (spreadsheet) with owner assignments and ETAs; we'll update it as tickets are resolved.

If that works for Acme, we'll generate a secure transfer (ShareFile/OneDrive S2S link) and a separate password message. Let us know if you require additional evidence (PR links or short screen captures) for high/critical items; Eng can provide those by 2026-08-11.

Markus Klein
Director, Technical Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: remediation_tracker-20260806.xlsx; redwood_redacted_pt_report_acme_2026-07.pdf (to be delivered)]
